questions.question: South Africa Women played their first ODI in August 1997, 25 years after their last Test before an extended absence from international cricket. Who was the opponent, and where was it played?
questions.explanation: South Africa's first ODI after readmission to international cricket was against Ireland at Stormont, Belfast, on 5 August 1997.

questions.question: At which ground did Kei record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 174, against Heat on 2018/02/10.

questions.question: At Bloemfontein Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
Who holds the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)' in the 08/09 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Shandré Fritz holds it, with a total of 49.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Sixes' in the 25/26 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Chris-Mari Bezuidenhout holds it, with a total of 17.
